title: Noor and the Terminal
author: Wren Brightwater
blurb: Zephyrine Thackeray, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
